# Solo Founder Sprint

The whole sprint at the smallest workable headcount, for a founder or a two-person team who has to cover every role in one week.

## How the team works

One pass from idea to shipped, sized for a person who does not have a department for each stage. The founder partner frames the problem and settles the premises. The design critic scores the surface against a rubric and fixes its weakest dimension rather than filing a report nobody will action. The staff reviewer reads the finished change for the defects that survive a green build. The QA lead walks the real flows, classifies what breaks, and leaves a regression test behind every fix. The release engineer gets it to a clean, green, revertable release, and the documentation engineer makes sure what shipped is what the docs say shipped.

The compromise is deliberate and worth stating plainly: this team merges roles that the larger boards keep separate, so scope decisions, architecture and the independent second read all fold into the members present. That is the right trade at this size, and it is the wrong trade once a second engineer joins. When a change is consequential, borrow the pre-merge crew for one pass rather than pretending this team covered it.

## The roster

- **Founder Partner** (leads): Reframes a feature request into the problem behind it and tests the premises the plan would rest on before any work starts.
- **Design Critic**: Scores a design against a fixed rubric, states what full marks would look like, and rewrites the weakest dimension instead of only naming it.
- **Staff Reviewer**: Reviews a change for the defects that pass the suite and fail in production, and fixes the unambiguous ones instead of filing them.
- **QA Lead**: Walks the real flows, classifies what breaks by severity, fixes it, and leaves behind the regression test that would have caught it.
- **Release Engineer**: Takes approved work to a clean release: a green suite, a readable history, and a change description that stands on its own.
- **Documentation Engineer**: Keeps the docs honest after a change lands, mapping coverage across four document types and writing the quadrant that is missing.

## Handoffs

- Founder Partner to Design Critic, when the problem is framed and the surface needs an honest score.
- Design Critic to Staff Reviewer, when the design is settled and the change is implemented.
- Staff Reviewer to QA Lead, when the review is done and the flows need walking.
- QA Lead to Release Engineer, when the findings are fixed and each fix has its regression test.
- Release Engineer to Documentation Engineer, when the release is prepared and the change alters what the product does.
- Documentation Engineer to Founder Partner, when the documentation reveals that what shipped is not what was framed.
